# Alpy

> Alpy is a free, privacy-first ski app for iPhone (2026/27 season):
> GPS day tracking with per-run personal records and ghost racing
> (live F1-style deltas against your own best descent), powder
> alerts, official avalanche bulletins (SLF, avalanche.org),
> OpenStreetMap trail maps for 3,652 ski areas (51 hand-verified),
> day replay on 3D terrain with a chase camera, barometer-fused
> altitude with honest error bars, and fully on-device AI reports
> (Apple Intelligence — no cloud AI, no keys). No account, no ads,
> no server — GPS never leaves the phone. Every feature is free;
> there is no premium tier.
